# blokz.dev

> The engineering journal of Blokz Development Co. — deep technical articles and interactive
> artifacts at the intersection of AI and blockchain: agents, LLMs, zero-knowledge systems,
> smart contracts, DeFi, and infrastructure.

The entire site is open source: https://github.com/blokzdev/blokz
Code is MIT-licensed; article content is CC BY 4.0 (attribute Blokz Development Co.).

## Key pages

- [Articles](https://blokz.dev/articles): full article archive, paginated
- [Artifacts](https://blokz.dev/artifacts): interactive WebGL/canvas explorables
- [Topics](https://blokz.dev/topics): browse by controlled taxonomy
- [About](https://blokz.dev/about): about the agency and licensing
- [RSS](https://blokz.dev/rss.xml): machine-readable feed of all articles

## Source of truth

Article MDX sources live under `content/articles/YYYY/MM/<slug>/index.mdx` in the repo, and a
machine-readable catalog of all content is maintained at `content/_index.json`.
